caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical wooden butter churn with a slightly wider base than the top. The body is composed of vertical wooden staves held together by three horizontal metal bands, one near the top, one around the middle, and one closer to the base. The wood is light brown with subtle variations, and the grain is visible. A vertical wooden dasher stick protrudes from a circular opening in the churn’s flat lid. The churn and dasher are rendered in natural shades of brown, with shading that conveys a three-dimensional effect. The background is plain and off-white, and no other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Wooden Churn
